Plate 1 · Flow

A ticket moves left to right through gates

Commands orchestrate; personas never dispatch personas (spawn depth 1). A persona hangs under the command that names it. Amber diamonds are decisions only a human makes.

human decisionpersona that can change filesread-only personadashed = conditional

Outside the gates: /explain — Render a built candidate as one HTML review page — requirement trace, touched modules, findings, rollback — from existing artifacts only.

Plate 2 · Context

What every session loads

AGENTS.md, linked as Claude's CLAUDE.md and Codex's AGENTS.md, and settings.json.

AGENTS.md · 8 rules, each naming what it catches
  1. 1
    Think Before CodingDon't assume. Don't hide confusion. Surface tradeoffs.Catches: confidently building the wrong thing.
  2. 2
    Simplicity FirstMinimum code that solves the problem. Nothing speculative.Catches: a 200-line solution to a 20-line problem.
  3. 3
    Surgical ChangesTouch only what you must. Clean up only your own mess.Catches: unrelated diffs that make review impossible.
  4. 4
    Goal-Driven ExecutionDefine success criteria. Loop until verified.Catches: declaring success without running anything.
  5. 5
    Deterministic Before ProbabilisticCatches: paying latency and nondeterminism for work if/else would do.
  6. 6
    Surface Conflicts, Don't Average ThemCatches: inventing a novel pattern nobody chose.
  7. 7
    Fail LoudCatches: silent gaps the reader assumes were covered.
  8. 8
    Modules Communicate Through ContractsNever reach across a module boundary. Consume the published interface.Catches: hidden coupling that turns every change into a cross-module break.

Also: Session and context, Writing for humans, Worktrees, Agent orchestration, Models, Durable project records.

Plate 4 · Guards

Where a rule stops being a sentence

Every hook binding at the moment it fires, with the first line of the script's own header and the self-test that exercises it.

  1. Session startsbefore any work
    warn-stale-base.sh
    every session

    Warns when the base a ticket is about to be built on is behind the remote default branch.

    tested by test-worktree-hooks.sh
  2. A persona is dispatchedPreToolUse · Agent|Task
    require-worktree-for-writers.sh
    every session

    Writers require a verified ticket checkout or feature branch and current project test infrastructure.

    tested by test-worktree-hooks.sh
  3. Any shell commandPreToolUse · Bash
    block-destructive-bash.sh
    every session

    Hard-blocks a short list of commands that are almost never intentional and hard to undo.

    tested by test-hooks.sh
    warn-force-push.sh
    every session

    Force-pushing to main/master always asks, everywhere — it's the harder-to-undo case regardless of surface.

    tested by test-hooks.sh
    require-isolated-test-runner.sh
    every session

    Denies a bare test-suite run when the project ships an isolating runner and more than one worktree is live.

    tested by test-isolated-test-runner.sh
    block-agent-push.sh
    executor, test-engineer (frontmatter)

    Hard-denies anything that moves work off the machine: git push in every spelling, and the gh commands that push or publish for you.

    tested by test-hooks.sh
  4. A writer tries to finishSubagentStop
    require-handoff-report.sh
    executor, test-engineer (frontmatter)

    The orchestrator otherwise takes "done" on faith; this refuses to let an executor or test-engineer finish until its final report carries what the persona already promises: verification commands *wi…

Plate 5 · Methodology

18 skills

6 are explicit: their Codex adapter sets allow_implicit_invocation: false, so a stage or role loads them, never a keyword match.

adr-recording

Records a technical/architectural decision as one file in that project's docs/adr/*.md, in the Decision/Rejected format this machine uses everywhere.

api-and-interface-design

Guides stable API and interface design.

browser-testing-with-devtools

Tests in real browsers via Chrome DevTools MCP.

c4-architecture

Generates a C4 model architecture workspace (Context and Container by default; Component, Deployment, and Dynamic views opt-in) for a codebase by ins…

code-review-and-qualityexplicit

Conducts multi-axis code review across correctness, readability, architecture, security, and performance.

context-engineering

Optimizes agent context setup.

deprecation-and-migration

Manages deprecation and migration.

dotfiles-sync

How to add, edit, or relink files in this dotfiles/setup_scripts repo so dotfiles/tools/setup/link_dotfiles.sh and dotfiles/README.md's synced-files…

executor-development-disciplineexplicit

Implements a planned task through thin behavioral slices, test-driven development, focused verification, evidence-driven retries, and atomic commits.

git-workflow-and-versioning

Git workflow safety and version-control discipline.

incremental-implementationexplicit

Delivers changes in small, verifiable increments.

jira-ticket

Jira ticket intake only.

laravel-worktree-isolation

Set up a Laravel repository so its test suite runs isolated per git worktree — separate database and Redis keyspace — enabling parallel ticket work.

planning-and-task-breakdownexplicit

Breaks an approved spec into ordered tasks.

project-docs

Create or refresh repository documentation from the actual project.

security-and-hardening

Hardens code against vulnerabilities.

spec-driven-developmentexplicit

Create or revise a specification for a feature, significant change, or bugfix before planning implementation.

test-driven-developmentexplicit

Drives development with tests.

Plate 7 · Self-tests

18 CI steps on every push to main and every pull request

Every deterministic check. The live workflow runner and real spec runs stay manual; they spend tokens.

StepRuns
Preflight — required toolsfor tool in bash git jq python3; do
command -v "$tool" >/dev/null || { echo "missing: $tool"; exit 1; }
done
jq --version && python3 --version && git --version
Hooks — deny, ask, and allow casesEnforcement: the three PreToolUse hooks, deny/ask/allow, including the alias, typo, global-option and quoted-target bypasses (adr/0049).bash dotfiles/tools/tests/test-hooks.sh
Hooks — handoff report gateEnforcement: the SubagentStop handoff gate — complete, partial, claim-only, second attempt, unknown agent, unreadable transcript.bash dotfiles/tools/tests/test-handoff-hook.sh
Hooks — worktree base guardsEnforcement: the two worktree-base guards (adr/0057). Real git fixtures -- bare origin, main checkout, linked worktree, feature branch -- because both hooks decide from git state.bash dotfiles/tools/tests/test-worktree-hooks.sh
Hooks — isolated test runnerEnforcement: the isolated test-runner gate, evidence-gated on the project shipping bin/worktree-test.sh and more than one live worktree.bash dotfiles/tools/tests/test-isolated-test-runner.sh
Frontmatter and settings pinsDeclarations: persona tool grants, writer hook attachment, settings pins.python3 dotfiles/tools/checks/validate-frontmatter.py
python3 dotfiles/tools/tests/validate-frontmatter-test.py

python3 dotfiles/tools/tests/validate-artifact-paths-test.py
Harness cross-referencesPipeline: every cross-reference between harness files resolves. A stage that cannot read its own reference proceeds from the skill body alone.python3 dotfiles/tools/checks/check-references.py
python3 dotfiles/tools/tests/check-references-test.py
Harness map is currentThe harness map is generated from the sources it describes; a change to a persona, hook, command, skill, reference or CI step that did not regenerate it fails here (adr/0069).python3 dotfiles/tools/checks/harness-map.py --check
Spec-eval judging logicSpec eval: the judging half only. Producing a spec drives the real model and stays manual.cd dotfiles/tools/evals/spec-eval && python3 test_judge.py
cd dotfiles/tools/evals/spec-eval && python3 test_produce.py
Plan-recall scoring logicPlan-localization recall scoring (adr/0067). Scoring a real ticket needs its project checkout and stays manual.cd dotfiles/tools/evals/plan-recall && python3 test_recall.py
Workflow runner logicOrchestration: the workflow runner's own assertion and fixture logic. NOT the live cases — those spend tokens and stay manual.cd dotfiles/tools/evals/workflow && python3 -m unittest -q test_runner
Codex skill installerInstallation: preflight conflict detection and injected-failure rollback.python3 dotfiles/tools/tests/test-install-skills.py
Codex native roles and hook adapterspython3 dotfiles/tools/tests/test-codex-harness.py
